name: Silent Sisterhood
legend: The Null Maidens of the Silent Sisterhood bring with them the nightmare pall of their collective null aura, afflicting their opponents with a creeping sense of dread.
description:
• When mustering your army, you can select a friendly Anathema Psykana Character model to be your WARLORD.
  • Friendly Prosecutor SQUAD units have BATTLELINE.
  • Friendly Anathema Psykana units have the following ability:
Creeping Dread (Aura): In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit/below starting strength makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

name: Assemblage of Might
legend: The Emperor’s Custodians will gladly test their mettle against the worst the galaxy has to offer.
description: In your Command phase, you can select one enemy unit to be a dreadful foe unit until the start of your next Command phase. Friendly Adeptus Custodes Character models’ attacks that target a dreadful foe unit have +1 to wound rolls.

name: Overwhelming Magnificence
legend: To confront the towering, auramite-clad warriors of the Adeptus Custodes across an open battlefield is terrifying enough. To meet them in the cramped confines of a voidship is so overwhelming as to render many foes witless.
description: While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit.

name: Priority Quarry
legend: With merciless efficiency, the Sisters of Silence mark their priority prey amidst the maelstrom of shiphoard combat, then focus on their elimination above all else.
description: At the start of the first battle round, you can select up to two enemy units to be your army’s quarry, one of which must be your opponents WARLORD. Each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army makes an attack that targets one of your army’s quarries, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army declares a charge, it can include one or more of your army’s quarries as targets of that charge, even if they are not visible to it.

name: On Gilded Wings
legend: Terminator sodalities are swept up by golden drop craft, ready to be deployed once more as battle demands.
description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit is unengaged, you can place that unit in strategic reserves.

name: Moritoi Ancients
legend: The auramite giants of the Moritoi are terrifying to behold, moving with the grace of mortal warriors. Wounds serve only to increase the ferocity with which they slaughter their foes.
description:
• While a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit is at starting strength, that unit has +2 OC.
  • While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below starting strength, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below half-strength, that unit’s attacks can:
    • Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
    • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

name: Wardens of the Dark Cells
legend: Inured to the most nightmarish and esoteric threats, the Shadowkeepers will not be swayed from their duty.
description:
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, melee attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Kaptaris
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

name: Martial Mastery
legend: The Custodians are masters of all forms of war. There is no foe, no matter how numerous or powerful, that they cannot lay low.
description:
In the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight, that unit’s melee attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1].
  • Or: [Lethal Hits].

name: Companion’s Watch
legend: Among the Companions and the Sentinel Guard, vigilance is the most crucial of attributes.
description: While a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

name: Talon Sortie
legend: The Solar Watch utilise speed, mobility and the adaptable Calistus Ka’tah to confound and eviscerate opposing armies.
description:
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to charge.

Favoured ka’tah: Calistus
Additional Effect: Your unit has +2" M.

name: Magna Imperator
legend: The Adeptus Custodes are blessed with gifts the Emperor has given them – physical might, mental robustness and the most powerful arms and armour available.
description:
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to attack, that unit’s attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.

Favoured ka’tah: Rendax
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with your unit and roll one D6:
  • On a 1-2, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
  • On a 3-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
  • On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

name: Heralds of the Throne
legend: The Emissaries Imperatus prioritise the mission over individual actions. Their favoured ka’tah, Conservai, similarly emphasises strategy.
description:
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units have Fights First.

Favoured Ka’tah: Conservai
Additional Effect: Until the end of the turn, being selected to make an advance/fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

name: Gilded Guardians
legend: Resilient experts of ranged warfare, the Aquilan Shield give no ground and punish advancing enemies with their mastery of the Salvus Ka’tah.
description:
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, ranged attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Salvus
Additional Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.

name: Flare Shields
legend: Many Adeptus Custodes vehicles are fitted with flare shields: relics of the Dark Age of Technology that can deflect incoming fire.
description: Friendly grav-assault units have 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

name: Instruments of the Emperor’s Wrath
legend: Favouring the aggressive Dacatarai fighting style, the Custodians of the Dread Host seek to outmatch their enemies in bloody melee combat.
description:
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units can re-roll charge rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Dacatarai
Additional Effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a pile-in/consolidation move, -2" from that pile-in/consolidation move.
